thread:
anika: FYI starting bring-up for a q6b-int4-alt variant on Dedicated. Need prompt-cycle ownership: reseed promptbank, light dedupe, labeler pulses, and a small golden refresh for regression checks. Who can coordinate the labeling windows and dedupe run?

mike: I can take dedupe + overlap matrix. Plan to run tokenized-hash compare before canonicalization. ETA ~24h.

sara: +1. Please freeze sampling schema for this wave (no anchor swaps). Also we need a tokenizer map tweak for int4 tokenization quirks.

oliver: I'll run perf + quality smoke (bench + eval harness). Need ~200-300 canary prompts including long-context, code, and short QA. Post them and I'll queue the bench.

anika: @oliver adding gist `https://gist.github.com/rw/pcycle-canary-v1` with an initial 250 items. Planning a 1k holdout for regression thresholds.

label-bot: ingestion: task=label-pulse-1 dataset=pcycle-q6b-int4-2026-03 expected_size=300 status=queued

mike: quick Q: dedupe sim threshold? default 0.9? I'll run with 0.92 to be conservative unless we decide otherwise.

sara: use 0.92 for paraphrase dedupe and 0.85 for short-form (<=20 tokens). Document in PR.

anika: I'll open PR to freeze sampling + add golden patch. Will pin eval config at `evals/configs/q6b_int4_small.json`.

oliver: After bench I'll publish model + tokenizer artifacts. If quality regression > 2% on golden_v2 -> fallback to q6b-int8 and abort rollout.

mike: kicked off dedupe command locally: `./scripts/dedupe.sh --thresh 0.92 --seed 42`

sara: tagging label ops: @jen can you help schedule two labeler pulses tomorrow AM? Need priority by entropy and edge-case coverage.

jen: on it. I'll reserve two 3hr slots and add to the label-ops calendar. Will coordinate with ops for capacity.

anika: also adding lightweight eval command for consistency checks: `python run_eval.py --gold=gold_v2.json --model=artifacts/q6b_int4.tgz --report=reports/q6b_int4_smoke.json`

label-bot: label-pulse-1 assigned to jen; progress webhook enabled (webhook=/hooks/label-pulse-1).

oliver: I'll wait for dedupe output + canary list then run bench. ETA ~6h after files land.

mike: dedupe output pushed to s3: `s3://redwood-curation/pcycle/q6b_int4/dedupe_out.json.gz` (sha256: 3b7f...).

sara: noted. once label pulse done we'll select ~200 examples to promote into `golden_v3` (mix of long/short/code).

jen: scheduled pulses: 2026-03-24 09:00-12:00 PT and 13:00-16:00 PT, added to #label-ops calendar and ops pager.

anika: perfect, thanks all :white_check_mark: I'll open a follow-up thread with the run logs and a promotion checklist when we have results.

mike: ack.

oliver: ack, standing by for artifacts.

sara: thanks, team.
